usage: The word 喜鵲 (hei2zoek3) refers to a type of bird called a magpie.
In sentences, 喜鵲 can be used as the subject or the object when talking about the bird.
It is typically used to talk about the animal itself or related behaviors in nature.
喜鵲 can appear in both formal and informal contexts, especially in nature conversations or stories.
You can add descriptive words before 喜鵲 to specify things like 'big magpie' or 'black magpie'.
